A dark feeling washes over everyone. A feeling of doom that shakes you to your very bones.

A handful of houses are on fire and you watch around, yourself an apparition in the world, as women are taken from houses and thrown on the ground by Spanish troops wearing Christopher Columbus' coat of arms. The air is hard to breathe from the smoke. Stakes and fire wood is being carried by other guards to the East over the mountain. Rope is being gathered.

One of the women lashes out, sending an arc of lightning into a string of men and frying their armor before she is tackled and bound.

Everyone's wrists begin hurting as if worn raw and their feet feel heavy.

The vision closes from around you and all you can see is your vision zooming over the peak and across a river. At the edge of a forest and atop a clifftop is a massive tree. 7 bodies swing there.
